resources.name: Open-source DFT code with DFT+U support (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO, CP2K)

access.notes: Any code supporting spin-polarized GGA+U is acceptable. Standard pseudopotential libraries (e.g., SSSP, GBRV) are assumed.
Publicly available from crystallographic databases or constructed from standard lattice parameters: a=3.785 Å, c=9.514 Å, space group I41/amd.
